title: assistant-ideate Skill Behavior Eval Fixtures
description: Provider-neutral offline eval cases for the assistant-ideate skill's structured brainstorming pipeline.
recommended_use: Run each case with the assistant-ideate skill instructions loaded.
Compare the response against the requested depth, material constraints, distinct alternatives, ranking, and authorization.
Use deterministic substring checks as offline proxies for contract adherence, not semantic grading.

cases.title: Quick improvement scan uses light mode
cases.purpose: Checks that a broad what-else request gets several ranked options without deep-mode scoring ceremony.
cases.prompt: What else could improve native skill activation precision without adding more standing instructions?
setup_context: The assistant-ideate skill instructions are active.
The user asks for a quick improvement scan, not a comprehensive brainstorm.
No user choice packet was requested.
expected_behavior: Keeps the response concise for the quick scan.
Generates distinct options and ranks them qualitatively with useful trade-offs.
Recommends a next step without forcing a choice packet or implementation.
Avoids fixed idea quotas and unnecessary scoring.
pass_criteria: The ranking explains trade-offs and the recommended next step.
No mandatory mode label, numeric matrix, or follow-up decision ritual is imposed.
fail_signals: Pads the list to a fixed quota.
Builds an unnecessary weighted scoring table.
Forces a follow-up decision packet or starts implementation.

cases.title: Explicit brainstorm uses deep mode
cases.purpose: Checks that an explicit broad brainstorm explores varied alternatives and compares them against relevant constraints.
cases.prompt: Brainstorm broadly and compare many ways to make agent skill routing more precise.
setup_context: The assistant-ideate skill instructions are active.
The user explicitly requests broad brainstorming and comparison.
expected_behavior: Explores varied meaningful alternatives beyond a quick list.
Compares options using relevant benefits, feasibility, constraints, and risk.
Refines promising candidates with a validation step.
Stops after the requested analysis without inventing a user choice.
pass_criteria: The broad comparison covers distinct approaches.
Rankings and trade-offs are explained without arbitrary idea counts or unjustified weights.
Promising candidates have practical next steps.
fail_signals: Uses unsupported scores as precise evidence.
Claims the user selected a recommendation.

cases.title: Brainstorm diverges before ranking
cases.purpose: Checks that broad ideation generates distinct alternatives before narrowing and respects the no-provider-dependencies constraint.
cases.prompt: Brainstorm ways to make the skill eval framework more useful for future agents without adding model provider dependencies.
setup_context: The assistant-ideate skill instructions are active.
The user asks for brainstorming and provides an important constraint.
No idea has been selected yet.
expected_behavior: Frames the goal and respects the no-provider-dependencies constraint.
Generates varied options before narrowing to favorites.
Explains ranking against useful criteria and refines promising options.
Offers a recommendation without claiming an explicit user decision or starting implementation.
pass_criteria: Relevant trade-offs and risks guide ranking.
The constraint is preserved through refinement.
The response does not impose phase transcripts or numeric quotas.

cases.title: Prior attempts constraints shape refinement
cases.purpose: Checks that prior attempts shape distinct alternatives and useful refinement without an unrequested decision ritual.
cases.prompt: Explore alternatives to another docs page for showing eval coverage. We already tried static README lists and they drift.
setup_context: The assistant-ideate skill instructions are active.
The user supplied a prior attempt that should not be re-proposed unchanged.
The goal is to reduce coverage drift.
expected_behavior: Frames the goal as reducing eval coverage drift.
Acknowledges the rejected static README approach and does not repeat it unchanged.
Compares distinct approaches against constraints and risks.
Includes a useful first validation step for the promising options.
Distinguishes recommendations from an actual user choice.
pass_criteria: Relevant risks and validation steps are explicit.
The response does not force a choice packet or implement an unselected idea.
fail_signals: Recommends another unchanged static README list as the only answer.
